description: Check whether a domain name is registered or available, via the official RDAP registry protocol (404 = available). For registered domains it also returns the registrar and creation/expiration dates — useful when an agent needs to name a product or verify how long a business has existed. Use this when an agent needs to is this domain taken? Registry answer, not a landing page. x402 price $0.001/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_domain_availability
title: Domain Availability Check
